# JAAD

Joint Attention in Autonomous Driving video and pedestrian behavior annotations.

## Intention in this dataset

Predict a pedestrian's future crossing behavior from preceding observations; a later crossing action is not a direct report of the pedestrian's mental intention.

**Relevance:** `implicit` �� **Origin:** `real` �� **Year:** 2017

**Domains:** pedestrian, autonomous_driving  
**Intention types:** pedestrian_crossing  
**Tasks:** behavior_prediction, trajectory_prediction  
**Modalities:** rgb, trajectory, vehicle_telemetry  
**Formats:** video, time_series, structured_annotation

## Relevant annotations

| Target ID | Meaning | Provenance | Scope | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `crossing_action` | Pedestrian crossing behavior used to construct crossing sequences. | behavior_derived | JAAD_beh crossing tracks and JAAD_all additional non-crossing visible pedestrians under the WACV 2021 sampling protocol. | [official](https://github.com/ykotseruba/JAAD), [wacv_protocol](https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/WACV2021/papers/Kotseruba_Benchmark_for_Evaluating_Pedestrian_Action_Prediction_WACV_2021_paper.pdf) |
